This issue records interest in evaluating the isolated, non-consensus [PoW v1 external attack challenge](https://github.com/emilydarryl/decentralized-currency-protocol/blob/main/docs/pow-v1-external-attack-challenge.md). Volunteering does not grant repository authority or certify reviewer independence.

Do not include credentials, private keys, personal data, unrevealed evaluator salts, or sensitive host information.

- Name or pseudonym:

## Review areas

Check any areas you can review:

- [ ] Attack-algorithm source
- [ ] Mutable-memory allocation ledger
- [ ] Operation-counter mapping
- [ ] Reproducible build and dependencies
- [ ] Disposable network-disabled execution
- [ ] Compiler stack evidence
- [ ] Physical-memory measurement
- [ ] Canonical proof and artifact verification

## Relevant experience

Describe relevant systems, cryptography, compilers, performance, sandboxing, or hardware experience. Formal credentials are not required; reproducible work matters more than titles.

## Independence and conflicts

Disclose project contributions, copied code, shared authorship, private coordination, financial interests, employment relationships, and prior access to any submission you may review.

- Operating system and architecture:

## Attestation

- [ ] I read the [external evaluator runbook](https://github.com/emilydarryl/decentralized-currency-protocol/blob/main/docs/pow-v1-external-evaluator-runbook.md).
- [ ] I will not run untrusted submissions on a personal, production, wallet, mining, or credential-bearing host.
- [ ] I will not publish or reuse an evaluator salt before the corresponding source freeze.
- [ ] I will disclose conflicts and preserve favorable, unfavorable, partial, invalid, and ineligible evidence.
- [ ] I understand that artifact validation does not prove physical-memory eligibility and that no successful submission does not prove security.
